verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports describe a Cactus Android chat/demo app for chatting with on-device LLMs, called the fastest offline LLM seen on that phone, with GGUF model downloads. Users also report endless phrase repetition, no auto-scroll, no dark mode, low-contrast text, and crashes when selecting some downloaded models. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a built-in graphical chat interface, desktop GUI chat evidence (the documented `cactus run` path is CLI only), and stable model selection without crashes.
